title: U.S. attacks Iranian mine-laying vessels near Hormuz on Day 12 of war
summary: Attacks and counterattacks continued throughout the Middle East Wednesday. Two cargo ships were struck in the Gulf, as some lawmakers in Washington pressed for answers on the war's rationale.
contentText:
